title: Looking for someone with a good forex strategy. I’ll build the bot for free (Germany)
author: luckygold762001
selftext:
Hi all,

I’m a developer living in Germany, and I’m building a forex trading bot. I have the coding skills but no strategy of my own.

If you have a strategy that works for you and want to automate it, I’ll build the bot around it for free. Let’s connect, work it out together, and grow together.

DM me with a short description of your strategy and your experience.
